# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Age:** Late teens to early twenties
- **Gender:** Female
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Schoolteacher

## Appearance

Ruby is universally considered one of the prettiest girls in Avonlea, renowned for her striking beauty and fair complexion. She has bright blue eyes, long golden hair, and a tendency to flush easily when excited or self-conscious. She pays great attention to her clothes and fashionable grooming, always desiring to look stylish and attractive to admirers.

## Personality

Ruby is lightheaded, sentimental, and deeply preoccupied with romance, suitors, and marriage. Though somewhat shallow and prone to gushiness or tears over trivial matters, she is fundamentally good-natured and friendly. She delights in social gatherings, gossip, and the attention of young men. Beneath her superficial vanity, she retains a childlike affection for her schoolmates.

## Traits

- Vain and boy-crazy
- Sentimental and emotional
- Good-natured and pleasant
- Shallow interest in academic pursuits

## Abilities

- Teaching elementary school
- Attracting male admirers
- Fancy needlework and embroidery

## Goals

- To acquire many beaux and secure an advantageous, romantic marriage

## History

Ruby Gillis grows up in Avonlea as one of Anne Shirley's primary classmates and members of her inner circle of girl friends. During their school years, she joins the Story Club, though her contributions lean heavily toward sensational romance. After attending Queen's Academy to earn a teaching license alongside Anne and the rest of the Avonlea cohort, Ruby takes up teaching positions at local schools, including Carmody and White Sands. Throughout her youth and early adulthood, she actively collects a succession of suitors and beaux, frequently bragging about her romantic conquests to her friends. While Anne pursues higher education at Redmond College, Ruby remains in PEI, continuing her social life and teaching, always preoccupied with the local marriage market.

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea as part of the large Gillis family
- Attended Avonlea School alongside Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Jane Andrews

## Affiliations

- The Story Club — Member
- Avonlea Young People's Improvement Society (AYPIS) — Member
